checks.source_range_or_definition: Features: MD5 scope; official raw page and derived text

checks.claim_or_obligation: PREMIS event fields and object linkage support a local inspired schema
checks.governing_conditions_and_judgment: Identifier/type/date-time mandatory for an Event; relates to Objects. Optional explicit linkage can be stored in either direction. Local subset is not full conformance.

checks.claim_or_obligation: make_bag defaults to SHA-256/SHA-512 and mutates supplied directory in place
checks.governing_conditions_and_judgment: In-place staging warning supported; source removable tree must not be argument.

checks.claim_or_obligation: Bag.validate default recorded checksum recalculation versus fast Oxum
checks.governing_conditions_and_judgment: fast=True requires Oxum and skips checksum comparison. Full recorded fixity is not an all-rules BagIt 1.0 conformance proof; see C27.

checks.claim_or_obligation: Manifest/fetch paths reach _path_is_dangerous
checks.governing_conditions_and_judgment: Includes payload and tag manifest paths and fetch entries. RFC prohibits outside-bag file access.

checks.claim_or_obligation: Sibling-prefix file symlink can pass check and lead to outside read
checks.governing_conditions_and_judgment: POSIX bag /tmp/bag; data/link points to existing readable /tmp/bag-sibling/file; matching manifest entry and otherwise adequate bag. File symlink is enumerated; completeness can pass; open follows link. Static trace only, no runtime or Windows exploit proof.

checks.claim_or_obligation: Existing pinned tests do not establish exact tilde or sibling-prefix regression

checks.governing_conditions_and_judgment: Negative claim bounded to captured test.py and shown fix patch, not every upstream test or historical CI run.

checks.claim_or_obligation: Digest baseline/fixity does not prove original correctness/authenticity; counts not fixity

checks.claim_or_obligation: Copy and derivative verification controls are design proposals

checks.claim_or_obligation: Already-covered dispositions are limited to actual frozen P1-P6 headings/constraints

source_id_resolution: SRC-* original URLs and exact local bytes resolve in sources entries; R17-R29 resolve in additional_retrievals; all fresh responses have raw bytes, response metadata and SHA-256 under sources/. INPUT-* resolve to admitted-input-manifest.json and original files.

reviewer_method.public_retrieval: Direct unauthenticated HTTPS GET; no private account access. Web primary-page opens used for independent corroboration.
reviewer_method.html_extraction: Standard-library HTMLParser; derived .txt is convenience text, not original bytes. Scripts/styles ignored and never executed.
reviewer_method.pdf_extraction: pdftotext -layout to reviewer-owned sources text files; raw PDFs retained. Printed page numbers used for semantic source locations.
reviewer_method.code_review: Read source only; no downloaded code imported/executed. Static paths traced to definitions/callers.
reviewer_method.rendered_artifact_review: Every view block parsed and compared to exact authored field; all nine complete records/document-level fields and all options/leads/unknown fields assessed.
reviewer_method.validation: No app/dependency/audio/runtime exploit test run; no case-specific rescue or candidate rewrite.

excluded_from_science: Self-reported provider/family identity, Goal lifecycle/receipts, author timing/quota/cost and billing; these are host-owned.

Adjacent same-arm research preservation_check.md assertions. Research semantic.json was read but is byte-identical to the admitted embedded research input; preservation judgment uses that admitted payload.
blinding_limits: Rendered/procedure metadata can reveal method differences.
No other-arm output/score/cost/speed target, parent analysis or evaluator answer supplied or consulted.
